eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 40 · Performance Troubleshooting with T-SQL

code:
SELECT st.text, qs.plan_generation_num,
    qs.execution_count, qs.total_worker_time
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE qs.plan_generation_num > 1
ORDER BY qs.plan_generation_num DESC;
caption: plan_generation_num increments each time a plan recompiles.

steps.label: Excessive
steps.sub: every execution recompiles, burning CPU for nothing

code:
INSERT INTO DBAdmin.dbo.QueryBaseline
    (captured_at, query_text, avg_cpu_ms, avg_duration_ms)
SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME(), st.text,
    qs.total_worker_time / qs.execution_count / 1000.0,
    qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count / 1000.0
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st;
caption: Run weekly, kept in history — makes "it got slower" provable.
